zones.label: Place de la Republique
zones.note: Frequent rally start point. Oct night curfew and gathering ban expired. Expect station closures and crowd controls on strike or march days. Approximate area.

zones.label: Chatelet-Les Halles
zones.note: Past curfew zone; still a dense hub where authorities close stations during unrest. Approximate area.

zones.label: Place de la Bastille
zones.note: Frequent march corridor (e.g. Republique to Nation). Approximate area.

zones.label: Place de la Concorde
zones.note: Yellow-vest Acte IV called a Saturday Nov 7 afternoon gathering here from 2pm. Prefects often ban or reroute central routes. Approximate area.

zones.label: Assemblee nationale
zones.note: Repeated protest focus near the Assembly. Expect heavy policing on mobilisation weekends. Approximate area.
